scope: Complete QKV producer/consumer scheduling redesign with existing row/cluster ownership; no head arithmetic approximation or input-format change.
full_graph: Existing preRMS and fullH BF16 ring32 broadcast -> separate Q and shared KV BF16 TRF; independent FP8 HBM weights -> inline lookup/fullH BF16 DPE on Main -> compact F32raw DM -> Sub channelScale -> firstBF16 -> Sub rowSwitch -> existing head typed gather -> Sub head RMS/RoPE -> original Q HBM and K/V cache stores.
removed_constraints: Q/K/V dot no longer uses Main VE for channel scale or ordinary BF16 cast
All head arithmetic and row/RoPE switches execute on Sub; Main reserved for input preprocessing/broadcast and projection DPE
retained_costs: 30MiB FP8 HBM and inline lookup work
original row ownership and head DMA gathers

added_costs.risks: Sub table/TRF/VRF readiness and head work contend; shared VE/transpose/DM arbitration, longer raw lifetimes and source-order-independent scheduling.

numerical_contract: Original fullH BF16 dot F32 accumulation -> F32 channel scale -> firstBF16; original head sum/div/EPS/sqrt/gamma/cast and RoPE multiply/add/BF16 boundaries unchanged.
prior_related: E55 scale-before-BF16 correctness; do not reintroduce E53 earlycast
C03 retained head gathers and old Main consumers (+1.56% NPU)
C08/E124 joint all-weight barrier and compactcopy (+24.41% NPU), not used
C12 O Main/Sub split failed overlap because weight readiness; require actual overlap here
first_gate: Exact full QKV compile; graph proves3Main DPE without VectorEngine/cast, compactF32spills total32768B,3Subscale beforeBF16,Subhead consumers; schedule reports actual MainDPE/SubVE intersection and complete makespan. An API/lowering error is not a hardware performance result.

decisions.adoption: Unvalidated. Positive full-kernel screen qualifies for independent repeats, extra inputs and boundary probes even below5%.
decisions.further_tuning: No tile sweep. First assess whether resource separation and overlap exist; fix supported API/layout errors with preserved attempts.
decisions.major_research: Test a different producer/consumer resource assignment including all handoff costs; no projection ownership/table reuse claim.

source_repair: v1 F32transpose4row exceeds native max_in_rows2; use supported2row8Bcompact commits. No arithmetic/layout ownership change; valid F32spill bytes unchanged.
